description: WRITE tool — remove a competitor from a product in the caller's Sonar workspace. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

competitor_app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of the competitor to remove (the competitor's `id`, NOT a store id).

product_id.description: Sonar product UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_list_products or sonar_create_product.

name: sonar_remove_competitor
title: Remove Competitor
